verifiedSurfaceSummary: Current runtime reconciles public WordPress counts/cards and native own-role criteria and workplace fields, then repeats details and final inventory. Corporate brief records remain observations until their publication and full criteria are proved. Native city-only addresses do not establish country, native post IDs do not establish formal requisitions, and private application fields are not public inventory prerequisites. All counts and qualification remain runtime-only; broader company and lifecycle scope stay unproved.
